title: When the Homecoming Wakes
premise: Vesper Underhill, the statistician for her school's championship-winning team, has quietly proven that the athletic program's miracle season is built on doctored eligibility records — a cover-up the school board buried years ago. When a college essay prompt asks students to describe a truth they regret not telling, Vesper's draft essay is accidentally published in the school literary magazine, and suddenly she's at the center of a scandal she never meant to start. As graduation looms, she and an unlikely found family of teammates, outcasts, and one guilt-ridden teacher race to expose the buried records before the board can destroy them and pin the fraud on the students. In the end, Vesper testifies at the final board meeting, trading her own clean record for the truth, and discovers that honesty costs less than the silence she was serving time for.
about_author: Quentin Amberdale is the pen name of a former high school debate coach who spent eleven years watching teenagers out-argue adults twice their age. Amberdale writes from a small coastal town where every gymnasium smells like floor wax and unfinished business.

chapters.title: The Arithmetic of Waiting
chapters.summary: Vesper, POV, introduces herself through numbers: days to graduation, points per game, the suspicious stat line that doesn't add up. She keeps her findings in a locked notebook. Emotional beat: numb resignation disguised as competence.

chapters.title: Essay Prompt #4
chapters.summary: Vesper's POV. English class receives the college prompt: 'Describe a truth you regret not telling.' Vesper writes honestly for the first time in years, then panics and tries to retract it. Beat: the first crack in her armor.

chapters.title: Published by Accident
chapters.summary: Vesper's POV. The literary magazine prints her draft essay under her name due to a submission mix-up. By lunch, half the school has read it. Star player Dez finds her first — not angry, but shaken. Beat: exposure, vertigo.

chapters.title: What Dez Knows
chapters.summary: Alternating POV begins: Dez, the team captain whose eligibility was faked without his knowledge, confronts Vesper in the equipment room. He thought he earned his spot. Beat: betrayal reframed as shared victimhood.

chapters.title: The Board's Quiet Meeting
chapters.summary: Dez's POV. The school board holds an unannounced session; Dez's aunt on the staff tips him off. They hear the phrase 'legacy documentation' and realize records are being moved. Beat: dread hardening into purpose.

chapters.title: Found Family, Assembled
chapters.summary: Vesper's POV. She, Dez, archivist nerd Priya, and burned-out teacher Mr. Okafor form an uneasy alliance in the library after hours. Beat: reluctant belonging — the first warmth in the book.

chapters.title: Numbers Don't Lie, People Do
chapters.summary: Priya's POV. Priya helps Vesper reconstruct the paper trail: transferred transcripts, backdated physicals, a signature that isn't a doctor's. Beat: the thrill of proof shadowed by fear of what proof invites.

chapters.title: Coach Calloway's Warning
chapters.summary: Dez's POV. Coach Calloway, complicit but protective of his players, privately begs Dez to let it go — 'the past stays buried or it buries you.' Beat: love against duty, first collision.

chapters.title: The Essay Goes Viral
chapters.summary: Vesper's POV. A regional news blog picks up the literary magazine piece. Reporters call the school; Vesper is summoned to the principal's office and offered a quiet deal: recant, get a glowing recommendation letter. Beat: temptation priced exactly right.

chapters.title: What Vesper Regrets
chapters.summary: Vesper's POV flashback chapter: why she stopped speaking up years ago after defending her brother and being disbelieved. Beat: memory as wound; the reader finally understands her silence.

chapters.title: Okafor's Confession
chapters.summary: Mr. Okafor's POV. He reveals he signed one of the falsified forms a decade ago as a young teacher, terrified of losing everything. He gives them the original file cabinet key. Beat: guilt converted into courage.

chapters.title: Locked Room, Open Secret
chapters.summary: Priya's POV. Nighttime break-in to the records annex using the key — they photograph the buried eligibility files just as a security guard rounds the corner. Beat: peak tension, near capture.

chapters.title: Suspended
chapters.summary: Dez's POV. Dez is suspended for 'unauthorized access' before the board meeting; the photos survive on Priya's drive but the originals are hauled away in boxes. Beat: the machinery closes around them.

chapters.title: The Team Chooses
chapters.summary: Vesper's POV. Vesper addresses the team, expecting rejection; instead the players vote to forfeit their tainted title if the fraud stands. Beat: found family becomes a force, not a refuge.

chapters.title: Calloway Crosses the Line
chapters.summary: Calloway's POV (first full chapter). He delivers the missing signature ledger to Vesper, ending his career to end the lie. Beat: duty inverted — loyalty to players over institution.

chapters.title: Countdown
chapters.summary: Vesper's POV. Three days to graduation and the board's final rubber-stamp session. The group prepares testimony while hackers-anonymous threats arrive at Priya's inbox. Beat: ticking clock, frayed nerves, fierce resolve.

chapters.title: The Deal Refused
chapters.summary: Dez's POV. The board offers Dez reinstatement and a scholarship if he denounces Vesper's 'misunderstanding.' He walks out mid-meeting. Beat: love against duty resolved in Dez's arc.

chapters.title: Final Session
chapters.summary: Vesper's POV. Climax: the public board meeting. One by one — Okafor, Calloway, Priya, the team — testify. Vesper presents the statistics and the photographs, voice shaking, then steady. Beat: catharsis.

chapters.title: Aftermath in Numbers
chapters.summary: Priya's POV. The superintendent resigns; the title is vacated; an independent audit begins. But Vesper's own transcript is flagged in retaliation. Beat: victory with a bill attached.

chapters.title: The Cost of Telling
chapters.summary: Vesper's POV. Facing a stained record days before applications close, Vesper writes her real college essay — about her brother, the silence, this year. Mr. Okafor and the team flood admissions offices with letters. Beat: grace arriving sideways.

chapters.title: Graduation
chapters.summary: Dez's POV. Graduation day: no championship banner hangs, but the whole team sits together, and Calloway watches from the bleachers as a free man. Vesper crosses the stage to actual applause. Beat: bittersweet, warm release.

chapters.title: When the Homecoming Wakes
chapters.summary: Vesper's POV epilogue. Months later, Vesper returns for homecoming to find the gym renamed for the students who testified, her notebook now a display case artifact. She answers the old essay prompt aloud, finally finished. Beat: memory honored, silence ended.
